label: New hair · Qwen Image 2.1
blurb: Changes the hair color or style of the person in Image 1. Face and everything else stay put.
source: ComfyUI template image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit (prompt enhancer left out)
tips: Give both color and cut for the most control.
